name: Cliques
overview: Scripture calls believers to unity and humility, warning against divisions that can arise from exclusive groups or cliques. Jesus reminds us that all believers are brethren under one Master, Christ, emphasizing the importance of brotherhood rather than elevating titles or status. Paul encourages the church to be of the same mind toward one another, avoiding pride and instead showing patience and condescension to those of lower estate. True fellowship in the house of God requires readiness to listen and a heart aligned with the Spirit, fostering unity rather than separation.
